STAGE: candidate selection and scope check (ideation_3, round_langgraph_trial_20261104)
GOAL: pick one coupling position not covered by the three rejected earlier rounds.
READ: the round brief's rejected list (poincare-frechet-successor-codebook = curved successor-Frechet CODEBOOK UPDATE; CURVCTRL-SID = per-LEVEL curvature from prefix transition score; BRad-RQ = behaviour-ranked RADIAL assignment; plus LORENTZ-SUCCPROFILE-SMOOTH-RQ, behcone-prefix-rq, succboost-geoshift).
OBSERVED: all three rejected rounds act on (a) codebook centroid movement, (b) per-level curvature scalar, (c) radial ranking of the assignment. None acts on the CHART in which the residual is expressed, i.e. on the basepoint of the exp/log map that carries the residual from level l to level l+1.
REASONING: choose a different degree of freedom: keep the codebook shared and unmoved, keep curvature fixed at c=1, and instead move the exponential chart of the residual to a behaviour-derived successor basepoint of the current PREFIX bucket, with a constant-free geodesic blend weight = quantisation-error / (error + behaviour gap). Removing behaviour collapses the blend to 0 (standard hyperbolic RQ); removing curvature collapses exp/log/Frechet to linear/Euclidean. Coupling is a single equation, so no standalone loss is needed.
STILL OPEN: none for the write-up; the mechanism is fully specified and constant-free.

STAGE: candidate selection and scope check (ideation_3).
GOAL: one coupling position not covered by earlier rejected rounds.
READ: rejected list = poincare-frechet-successor-codebook (curved successor-Frechet CODEBOOK update), CURVCTRL-SID (per-LEVEL curvature from prefix transition score), BRad-RQ (behaviour-ranked RADIAL assignment), plus LORENTZ-SUCCPROFILE-SMOOTH-RQ, behcone-prefix-rq, succboost-geoshift.
OBSERVED: all act on centroid movement, per-level curvature scalar, or radial ranking of the assignment. None acts on the CHART in which the residual is expressed, i.e. the basepoint of the exp/log map carrying the residual from level l to l+1.
REASONING: pick that free degree of freedom. Codebook stays shared and unmoved, curvature fixed at c=1; instead the exponential chart of the residual moves to a behaviour-derived successor basepoint of the item's current PREFIX bucket, with a constant-free blend weight = quantisation error / (error + behaviour gap). Behaviour off => weight 0 => plain hyperbolic RQ; curvature off => exp/log/Frechet collapse to linear/Euclidean. One equation, no standalone loss.
STILL OPEN: nothing blocking; mechanism is constant-free and fully specifiable.

STAGE: final answer (condensed record; full text printed in the reply).
IDEA: SUCC-CHART-RQ — successor-anchored exponential chart for the RQ residual.
MECHANISM: after level l picks code c, the residual is not passed on verbatim. x_{l+1} = exp_c((1-a)log_c(x_l) + a log_c(b_{l+1,i})), a = dP(x_l,c)/(dP(x_l,c)+dP(c,b_{l+1,i})+eps). b_{l+1,i} = weighted Poincare Frechet (Karcher) mean of ball-mapped encoder outputs of the top-M=16 successors of the item's current PREFIX bucket; q_{l+1}(j|i)= mean over bucket members of p(j|i), p from directed within-session transitions of the TRAIN split only. c=1 fixed, L=4, M=16, eps=1e-7, radius clamp 0.999, stop-grad on b and buckets, basepoints refreshed each epoch.
COUPLING: behaviour sets the basepoint AND the blend weight; curvature supplies log/exp/Mobius/Frechet. Behaviour off => a=0 => standard hyperbolic RQ. Geometry off => arithmetic mean, L2 distance, linear blend. Both-on is the only arm trained.
COST: ~12k curved ops/step (<1 ms, <5%); per-epoch refresh 24556x5x16x5x64 ~5e8 flops (~0.05 s), about 1.5e12 total over 3000 epochs.
WHY DISTINCT: earlier rounds moved centroids, per-level curvature, or radial ranks; this moves the chart/basepoint of the residual while leaving the codebook and curvature untouched.
HYPOTHESIS: prefix-successor predictability P(next item's level-(l+1) code | first l codes) rises at l=1..3 and Stage3 test_recall@10 > 0.065 in the single run.
RISKS: reconstruction drift, noisy early buckets, long-tail items with no successors, boundary NaNs, seed noise.
STATUS: complete, no run performed (round runs no ablation arm).
